items.stem: By studying Lewis's maps, the history of the marsh has become clearer to modern ecologists. Which is the best version of the underlined portion?
choices: NO CHANGE
there appeared the marsh's boundary more irregular than expected
Lewis's findings showed the marsh's boundary more irregular than expected
Lewis found the marsh's boundary more irregular than expected
items.stimulus: In 1934, surveyor Margaret H. Lewis began mapping the tidal marshes along Maryland's Eastern Shore. Lewis had trained as a civil engineer, but she became especially interested in how shifting channels altered the marshes' plant communities. Using a plane table and a hand level, the marsh's edges were plotted by Lewis during the first weeks of her survey. Lewis marked channels on her chart that curved sharply around stands of cordgrass. To make changing water levels easier to compare, Lewis added a series of symbols to her maps. While still visible from the water, Lewis's assistants recorded the flags' positions before the tide rose. After comparing her measurements with aerial photographs, <u>the marsh's boundary appeared more irregular than expected</u>. Lewis later donated the maps to the state archive, carefully wrapped in acid-free paper. The survey's results, published in a regional journal in 1937, helped establish a baseline for later studies. By studying Lewis's maps, <u>the history of the marsh has become clearer to modern ecologists</u>.
items.explanation: The introductory phrase “After comparing her measurements...” requires a person who performed the comparison. “Lewis found” supplies that logical subject and avoids making the marsh's boundary or an impersonal “there” appear to have done the comparing.

per_choice.correct: The introductory phrase “After comparing her measurements...” requires a person who performed the comparison. “Lewis found” supplies that logical subject and avoids making the marsh's boundary or an impersonal “there” appear to have done the comparing.

items.stem: Which is the best version of the underlined portion?

Having completed her Paris studies, Morgan's early work was several residences and churches.
Morgan received several early commissions for residences and churches after completing her Paris studies.

items.stimulus: Julia Morgan became one of California's most prolific architects during the early twentieth century. After studying civil engineering at the University of California, Berkeley, she traveled to Paris to attend the École des Beaux-Arts. In 1902, she returned to San Francisco and opened an office that eventually employed several draftspeople. Her projects included libraries, schools, and residences, many of which incorporated reinforced concrete. <u>Having completed her Paris studies, Morgan's early commissions included several residences and churches.</u> One of Morgan's best-known commissions was San Simeon, the estate developed for newspaper publisher William Randolph Hearst. Working from a steep hilltop, the estate's design incorporated Mediterranean forms and structural features suited to California's earthquakes. In the estate's towers and guesthouses, decorative details appear alongside practical systems for water and electricity. Reviewing these drawings today, the careful organization of Morgan's plans is apparent to historians. By comparing those records with surviving structures, modern scholars have learned how Morgan adapted her designs to local conditions.

per_choice.correct: The introductory modifier must describe Morgan, the person who completed the studies. Choice C makes Morgan the subject of the main clause and places the modifier logically after the verb.
